query:
SELECT u.id, u.open_id, u.name, u.role, u.insurer_role, u.tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
WHERE u.role IN ('admin', 'insurer')
LIMIT 5;
